title: unified-rollouts: staged shadow probing + proactive auto-rollback with multi-metric thresholds
author: Rui Chen
description: This PR implements staged shadow probing and proactive auto-rollback workflows for the unified rollouts controller. Motivation: operators need safer progressive delivery for model rollouts that can probe models with shadow traffic, progressively ramp canaries/A-B variants, and automatically rollback when multiple SLO metrics indicate degradation. Changes include a new staged shadow probing scheduler, multi-metric threshold evaluation with hysteresis and cooldown windows, observability improvements for metric matching and alerting, additional e2e tests and stability guards, and doc + examples for ops. The description below summarizes intent, high-level design, testing and rollout plan. Design notes: staged shadow probing runs short lived shadow probes across representative routes to validate semantic/latency/quality expectations before canary traffic is promoted; proactive auto-rollback computes weighted signal across configured metrics (latency p95, error-rate, perplexity/regression score) and triggers rollback with a configurable severity threshold and cooldown to avoid flapping. Backwards compatibility: controller defaults preserve existing rollout behavior unless a policy with staged_probing or proactive_rollback is defined. Linear tickets: ENG-4321 (staged shadow probing), ENG-4470 (multi-metric autorollback).

review_comments: Leah Brooks: Can we keep staged probing opt-in by default? We should avoid surprising customers during upgrade.
Rui Chen: Agreed, staged_probing defaults to off; added migration notes and explicit feature gate in docs.
Marco Alvarez: Multi-metric weighting looks good; please add a short-circuit if a single critical metric crosses an absolute safety cutoff (eg p95 > X ms) to speed rollback.
Rui Chen: Added absolute safety cutoff logic and unit tests for the short-circuit path.
Sana Iqbal: E2E flakiness observed in CI on first run; is the test using stable seed for traffic shaping?
Rui Chen: Flakiness fixed by using deterministic traffic generator and extending probe cooldown in low-QPS environments; re-ran CI.
Tom Rivers: Please add an observability dashboard example and recommended alert thresholds for customers.
Rui Chen: Added grafana dashboard JSON and recommended alert snippets in docs/release notes.
Leah Brooks: Approved after minor nits addressed (log levels and a doc clarifying defaults).
